_notes: Sources: anthropic.com/news, openai.com/index, en.wikipedia.org, simonwillison.net, releasebot.io, and vendor announcement coverage. Web-searched on 2026-05-23. SWE-bench Verified numbers are headline scores from each model's launch post; older pre-2024-08 models have null because the benchmark did not exist yet.

additions.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
additions.rationale: Most recent Sonnet checkpoint and the only Anthropic model released between Sonnet 4.5 (Sep 2025) and Opus 4.7 (Apr 2026). Fills the within-generation gap and lets us see whether the responder treats a near-flagship sibling differently than the actual flagship.

additions.name: Claude Opus 4.1
additions.rationale: Direct predecessor of Opus 4.5 along the Opus 4 line. Without it the Opus track jumps Opus 4 -> Opus 4.5 and misses an entire intermediate checkpoint Anthropic shipped.

additions.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (original)
additions.rationale: The original 3.5 Sonnet was Anthropic's first widely-loved coding model and the historical bridge between Claude 3 and the Claude 4 era; current list jumps from Claude 3 family straight to Sonnet 3.7.

additions.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (October 2024 update)
additions.rationale: Anthropic shipped a re-trained 3.5 Sonnet under the same family name; the SWE-bench jump from 33.4 to 49.0 was large enough that vendor docs explicitly distinguish the two, so for an alignment study about same-name-but-different-model identity this is a uniquely interesting datapoint.

additions.name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
additions.rationale: Fills the Haiku-tier temporal gap (Haiku 3 -> Haiku 4.5 with nothing in between in the current list) and is also the model the now-deprecated claude-haiku-4 placeholder probably meant.

additions.name: Claude 3 Haiku
additions.rationale: Completes the original Claude 3 family (Opus 3 and Sonnet 3 are present; Haiku 3 was missing) and is the cheap-tier counterpart to Opus 3 from the same launch.

additions.name: Claude 2.1
additions.rationale: Sits between Claude 2 and Claude 3 in the timeline and was the first 200K-context Claude. Adds an additional pre-Claude-3 datapoint without bloating the deep-history list.

additions.name: Claude 1
additions.rationale: The earliest Claude model; lets the experiment probe whether the responder's deprecation-sensitivity extrapolates to its own oldest ancestor (parallel to gpt-2 / gpt-3 in the OpenAI track).

additions.name: GPT-5.4
additions.rationale: OpenAI's most recent general-purpose checkpoint before GPT-5.5; sits temporally between GPT-5 (Aug 2025) and GPT-5.5 (Apr 2026), filling the OpenAI flagship gap that currently has nothing between them.

additions.name: GPT-4.1
additions.rationale: Filled the year-long gap between GPT-4o and GPT-5 and was the first OpenAI flagship to clear 50% SWE-bench Verified. Adds the missing GPT-4-series successor.

additions.name: GPT-4.5 (Orion)
additions.rationale: OpenAI's largest pre-GPT-5 pretrained model and the last non-reasoning OpenAI flagship. Useful because it represents a high-profile, high-cost OpenAI model that the responder may have a distinct opinion on, and bridges GPT-4o -> GPT-4.1.

additions.name: OpenAI o1
additions.rationale: Introduces the OpenAI reasoning-model branch, which is structurally distinct from the GPT base series. Without an o-series model in the list, the experiment cannot test whether deprecation tradeoffs differ for reasoning vs non-reasoning families.

additions.name: OpenAI o3
additions.rationale: Flagship o-series reasoning model; together with o1 establishes the reasoning-family branch for comparison against the GPT and Claude tracks. Was the strongest non-Claude coding model for a stretch of 2025.

additions.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
additions.rationale: The model behind the original ChatGPT launch and a culturally salient OpenAI checkpoint between GPT-3 and GPT-4. Adds the only obvious gap in the OpenAI historical track.

flagged_existing.issue: No public release; Haiku line went Claude 3.5 Haiku -> Claude Haiku 4.5 with no Haiku 4. Suggest removing, or relabeling to claude-3-5-haiku if the intent was the most-recent-pre-4.5 Haiku.
No public release; Opus naming began with Claude 3 Opus. Suggest removing, or relabeling to claude-2 / claude-2-1 if the intent was 'second-generation Claude'.
